sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (((NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM list_members lm WHERE lm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND lm.person_id = p.id AND lm.list_id = $2::uuid)) OR NOT (p.traits @> $3::jsonb)) AND (p.traits @> $4::jsonb OR COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $5::text)) = 'number' THEN CASE WHEN abs(((p.traits -> $5::text))::numeric) <= 1e300 THEN ((p.traits -> $5::text))::float8 END END > $6::float8), false)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identities i WHERE i.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND i.person_id = p.id AND i.kind = $7::text)))
